notes: Replaces the fragile iPhone execution of eight runtime wrapper scripts with a coherent fetch/decode/assemble loader. TEE now downloads all eight same-origin runtime parts, decodes their generated string payloads without depending on Safari executing each wrapper, assembles them in order, and initializes Add Document only after the complete runtime is present. Vault behavior and private data are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.22 — Coherent Traveler Runtime Assembly
